# Publications

## Preprints

<hr class="section-line">

-   **Y. M. Amali P. Rajapaksha, (2026). *Sri Lanka Dengue Dashboard: A Web-Based Decision Support Tool for Dengue Surveillance in Sri Lanka.* arXiv preprint arXiv:2608.07650.**

    [![PDF](https://img.shields.io/badge/PDF-arXiv-BA1B1B.svg)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.07650)   [![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.48550%2FarXiv.2608.07650-blue.svg)](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.07650)   <button class="bibtex-btn" onclick="copyBibTeX(this)"> <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/BibTeX-Copy-green.svg" alt="Copy BibTeX"/> </button>

```{=html}
<script>
function copyBibTeX(button) {

  const bibtex = `@misc{rajapaksha2026srilankadenguedashboard,
  title={Sri Lanka Dengue Dashboard: A Web-Based Decision Support Tool for Dengue Surveillance in Sri Lanka},
  author={Y. M. Amali P. Rajapaksha},
  year={2026},
  eprint={2608.07650},
  archivePrefix={arXiv},
  primaryClass={stat.OT},
  url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07650},
  doi={10.48550/arXiv.2608.07650}
}`;

  navigator.clipboard.writeText(bibtex).then(function() {

    button.innerHTML =
      '<img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/BibTeX-Copied!-brightgreen.svg" alt="BibTeX Copied">';

    setTimeout(function() {
      button.innerHTML =
        '<img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/BibTeX-Copy-green.svg" alt="Copy BibTeX">';
    }, 2000);

  }).catch(function() {

    const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");

    textarea.value = bibtex;
    textarea.style.position = "fixed";
    textarea.style.opacity = "0";

    document.body.appendChild(textarea);

    textarea.focus();
    textarea.select();

    document.execCommand("copy");

    document.body.removeChild(textarea);

    button.innerHTML =
      '<img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/BibTeX-Copied!-brightgreen.svg" alt="BibTeX Copied">';

    setTimeout(function() {
      button.innerHTML =
        '<img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/BibTeX-Copy-green.svg" alt="Copy BibTeX">';
    }, 2000);

  });

}
</script>
```
